title: Account — managing your email address and password
body:
On the **Account** tab you manage your login details, where we send notifications, your property's
time zone and — at the bottom of the page — the legal details published on your website (imprint, privacy notice).

The page has two parts: under **„Sign-in and notification”** you find your own login details, under **„Property details”** the time zone and the legal details. On a phone, the row of buttons at the top of the page (**Account · Property time zone · Legal details**) takes you to the part you want with one tap; on a computer the same list is on the right,
under the heading **„On this page”**, and it stays visible while you scroll.

![Screenshot: the Account tab on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## Where do I log in?

You always log in to the admin at **citoviso.com/login**, with your username and password.
If you lose track of it, you can find this address in several places:

- on the **Account** tab, in the **„Login address”** field (it is worth saving it to your browser bookmarks);
- in the "We have activated your order" email you receive after payment, in the **„Log in”** row, above your username;
- at the bottom of every email we send, in the "Login:" row;
- at the very bottom of your own website, on the "Host login" link;
- if you type **/admin** after your website's address (for example `example.citoviso.com/admin`), you reach the login page.

## Username

The **„Username (for login)”** field is for information only: this is the name you use to log in to the
admin. It cannot be changed — if you have a problem with it, write to us.

## First login: setting your password

We never send passwords by email. After ordering, you can set your own in two places:

1. **Straight away on the successful payment page.** In the "Set your password now" section, type the new
   password twice and tap the "Set and log in" button. This option is only available for two hours after payment.
2. **From the email.** On ordering, the "We have activated your order" email — in a free trial, the "Your login details" email —
   shows the **„Log in”** row (the login address) and the **„Username”** row separately, with a **„Set password”** button below them.
   The button is valid for 7 days and can be used once. On the page that opens, type the new password twice (at least
   8 characters), then tap the **„Set it and sign in”** button.

Once it is set, the system logs you in immediately. For security reasons, any sessions opened earlier are closed,
so you will need to log in again on other devices.

**If you continued after a free trial:** your account already exists, so the "We have activated your order" email has no button,
it only says: "Your password has not changed." You log in at **citoviso.com/login** with the same username and password
as during the trial. If you have forgotten it, see below: Forgotten password.

## Forgotten password

1. On the login page, tap the **„Forgot your password?”** link.
2. In the **„Username or email”** field, type your username or the email address you gave in the
   **„Communication email (we'll send notifications here)”** field (that is where we send the email, too),
   then tap the **„Send the link”** button.
3. The page always says the same thing: **„If such an account exists, we've sent it”**. This is deliberate, so nobody can test
   who has an account with us. If the address belongs to an account, an email arrives within a few minutes with a **„Set password”** button (valid for 7 days, can be used once).
4. If the link has expired or has already been used, the page says: **„This link is no longer valid”**. If you have already
   set your password, the **„Log in”** button takes you to the login page; if not, you can ask for a new one with the **„Request a new link”** button.

If you did not ask for the link, there is nothing to do: your current password stays unchanged.

## Communication email

In the **„Communication email (we'll send notifications here)”** (Communication email) field, give the email address
you read every day — important notifications arrive here, for example a new booking request.
Save the change with the **„Save email”** button.

## Changing your password

In the **„Change password”** section you can replace your password:

1. Type your current password in the **„Current password”** field — this confirms that it really is you.
2. Type the new one in the **„New password (min. 8 characters)”** field. A good password is one you remember
   but nobody else can guess — for example three unrelated words written together.
3. Repeat it in the **„Confirm new password”** field — this protects against typos.
4. Tap the **„Change password”** button. From your next login you use the new password.
   You stay logged in on this device, but on your other devices you will need to log in again after the change.

## Property time zone

The **„Property time zone”** card shows which time zone's clock we use for your property:
when a booking counts as "today", when a price or a request expires, and what time the guest sees.
By default it comes from the property's country (in Hungary, Budapest), so for most properties there is nothing to do here.
Only change it if your property is somewhere else — for example in the Canary Islands or in Portugal.

1. In the **„Search”** field, type the name of the nearest large city or the island (e.g. "Lisbon",
   "Canary", "Vienna"). The list narrows down; if there is no match, it says: "No such time zone. Try the
   nearest large city (e.g. "Lisbon")."
2. Choose the right one from the **„Time zone”** list. Below it you immediately see what time it is there now
   and which day counts as "today" there ("Now here: …").
3. If your choice differs from the default for the property's country, a warning asks you to
   check it. The **„Reset to country default”** button selects the country's default zone (e.g. Budapest)
   again.
4. Tap the **„Save time zone”** button. The button can only be pressed if you have really chosen
   something different from what was set before.

After saving, the booking calendar, expiring prices, booking requests and the deadlines of offers sent to
guests all follow this zone's clock. The dates of the invoices and contracts you receive from us
do not change: they follow the Hungarian calendar.

## Legal details

In the lower part of the tab, on the **„Legal details”** card, you enter what appears on your website's Imprint and
Privacy notice pages (company name, registered office, tax number, registration number).
A separate guide describes this in detail — it also explains what happens if a mandatory
detail is missing.

## Logging out

On a phone, open the drawer with the **„Menu”** button in the bottom bar: the **„Log out”** row is at its bottom; on a computer
the log-out icon at the bottom of the left-hand menu, next to your name, does the same. On a shared or someone else's device
(e.g. the reception computer) always log out when you finish — on your own phone you can stay logged in.
